description: This file defines several utility validation functions for form or input validation, such as required field check, minimum length, email format validation, and combining multiple validators.

methods.name: required(value, label = "This field")
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is non-null, non-undefined, and not an empty string after trimming; returns an error message if validation fails.

methods.name: minLen(value, len, label = "This field")
methods.description: Ensures the value's string length is at least the specified minimum; returns an error message if validation fails.

methods.name: email(value, label = "Email")
methods.description: Validates that the value matches a basic email pattern; returns an error message if invalid.

methods.name: combine(...validators)
methods.description: Creates a composite validator from multiple validator functions, executing them sequentially and returning the first error encountered.
